## Validation

Please confirm:

- [ ] I've read the [Package Curation Guidelines](../../docs/PACKAGE_CURATION.md)
- [ ] My description is 5-15 words
- [ ] My description focuses on what users can DO (not what the package IS)
- [ ] My description is clear to non-technical users
- [ ] Tags are lowercase and relevant
- [ ] Category is the BEST fit (not just a good fit)

## Examples for Reference

**Good Descriptions:**
- ✅ "Edit photos and create graphics" (GIMP)
- ✅ "Browse the web privately and securely" (Firefox)
- ✅ "Write code with intelligent completion" (VSCode)

**Bad Descriptions:**
- ❌ "A web browser" (too vague)
- ❌ "Advanced image manipulation program" (too technical)
- ❌ "Firefox is a free and open-source..." (too long)
